scanIssues.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
scanIssues.description: Response lacks "X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff" MIME-sniffing protection.
scanIssues.remediation: Add "X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff" to HTTP responses.

scanIssues.title: No Content-Security-Policy header detected
scanIssues.description: Adding a Content-Security-Policy header strengthens protection against XSS.
scanIssues.remediation: Configure a baseline Content-Security-Policy header.

scanIssues.title: Missing meta description
scanIssues.description: No <meta name="description"> tag found in document head.
scanIssues.remediation: Add a concise <meta name="description"> tag for search previews.

scanIssues.title: Incomplete OpenGraph social preview tags
scanIssues.description: Missing og:title or og:image limits rich card previews when links are shared.
scanIssues.remediation: Add <meta property="og:title"> and <meta property="og:image"> tags.

scanIssues.title: Fixed-width container (1280px) risks mobile overflow
scanIssues.description: Detected fixed CSS width "width: 1280px" which exceeds a 390px mobile viewport.
scanIssues.remediation: Use responsive max-width: 100% or media queries instead of wide fixed pixel widths.
